tagline: Every declared ingredient, checked against one shared standard.
description: Adult supplement declarations are checked against the applicable ingredient rules. Forms, quantities, product evidence and individual preferences remain visible without implying that every formula has the same purpose.

copy.unit_basis: Per serving. The types on this page do not share one comparison unit, so each product names its own.
copy.screening_note: Published references have a readable, complete ingredient declaration checked against the applicable ingredient restrictions in charter 0.15.0. This first filter does not certify nutritional quality, efficacy or laboratory testing.
copy.audience_note: This selection is for adults and does not determine individual medical suitability.
copy.guide_heading: How do you like your daily essentials?
copy.empty_body: We reviewed 23 daily essentials products reaching Kuwait and published none. Publication requires a completed ingredient check and an available Kuwait offer. Unresolved declarations and unavailable offers remain in the audit.

milk_allergy_empty.title: Nothing here is free of milk.
milk_allergy_empty.body: Every product published in this category declares milk, or has no dairy-free declaration we could read. We will not answer a declared milk allergy from silence.

director_selection.note: Editorial choices among ingredient-admitted references, recorded in the database.

types.name: Omega-3
types.purpose: EPA and DHA. The supplement most people take at a dose too small to matter.

types.name: Vitamin D3 & K2
types.purpose: The one deficiency that is near-universal in a climate where nobody trains outdoors at noon.

types.name: Magnesium
types.purpose: Sleep, cramp and recovery support. Form matters more here than in any other category.

types.name: Athlete Multivitamin
types.purpose: Insurance against the gaps a training diet leaves. Not a performance product.

types.name: Zinc
types.purpose: Immune and hormonal support, at a dose that does not displace copper.
